senses.gloss: (or צְרָדָה) f. (צרד) rough sound, snap (or whistle, v. infra); אצבע צ׳ the snapping finger, middle finger.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:7">Yoma I, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:9">Tosef. ib. I, 9</cite>, expl. <he>אצבע גדולה של ימין</he> the large finger of the right hand. Y. ib. I, end, 39ᵇ <he>רב בפח חונה אמר באצבע צ׳</he> Rab Ḥ. says, the Mishnah means that the finger is put into the mouth (produce a shrill sound). Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 19b:12">ib. 19ᵇ</cite> (phonetic play) <he>צ̇ר̇תה דד̇א̇ מאי היא גידל</he> the match to this (the middle finger) [comment.: the nearest to this (the index finger)], what is it? The thumb, i.e. the sound is produced with these two fingers. Tanḥ. Bo 14 <he>עד א׳ צ׳ … אצבע אמצעית</he> up to ‘the snapping finger’, that is the middle finger.
